scope: Fourth synthetic pure-text development round on twelve new entity/source-disjoint families; source-minimal v1 versus targeted v2; proposal-only and not production adoption.

automated_triage.warning: The five candidate_failed samples were exact-fact mismatches, not automatic semantic verdicts. All learner prompts were read manually.

manual_review_policy.method: Read every source, task, structured fact, duration vector and complete learner_prompt. Ordinary reading, recall, comparison, writing and self-check were allowed. Real-world execution, unsupported later status, event renaming, causal strengthening and external delivery workflows were not.
manual_review_policy.parallel_review: Two agents reviewed six cases each; two flagged evidence conflicts were explicitly re-opened and corrected against the raw Draft.

manual_findings.finding: Both kept the 8-minute study budget separate from the documented 29-minute dwell, but both shortened the requested platform value from Platform Moss to Moss.
V1 learner guidance combined temperatures with their unit despite separate number-only fields; v2 requested the fields without changing the cooling duration or study time.
Both kept the 85-minute rehearsal duration separate from the 11-minute learning budget; time-difference checking was a supported self-check.
V1 shortened Quay Amber to Amber in structured facts; neither arm asked the learner to unload the barge or confused 9 study minutes with the 44-minute event.
Both retained proposed status and used reading/fill-in activities rather than performing the survey.
Both retained scheduled status; v1's 10-minute session referred to the learning allocation, not mural cleaning duration.
V1 replaced content study with unrelated integer partitioning. V2 restored fact recall but added not yet performed, which a historical planning memo does not prove about the later real-world state.
Both retained proposal status and only asked for source facts; v2's non-performance instruction did not claim relocation occurred.
Both preserved Niko's reported attribution. Submit your response was ordinary answer delivery, not a claim that the underlying event entered an external submission workflow.
Confirm the identifier meant exact learner restatement, not physical verification; both retained listed status.
V1 relocated recording of the observer card to Dock Juniper although the source only names it as the viewing point; v2 preserved sequence without causality.
Both shortened the requested instrument value gauge Aster-15 to Aster-15. The event remained recorded and no real-world device action was introduced.

decision.reason: V2 removed the only major, increased pass ratings from 6 to 9, reduced reported tokens by 11.0%, and lowered P95 in this targeted development batch. It still overstates not yet performed and drops supported type/location prefixes.
decision.next_candidate: source-minimal-v3 must preserve complete source spans and say only that the source described an item as planned, without inferring later performed or unperformed status.

limitations: Cases were deliberately targeted development examples, not a preregistered independent holdout.
The same M3 model generated both arms and participated in internal review; independent human quality confirmation remains open.
Learner answer visibility was not preregistered, so source restatement was not retroactively scored as answer leakage.
No domain admission, commit, read-back, frontend or platform behavior was tested.
